response.sql: WITH matched_trades AS (SELECT DISTINCT tr.transreg, t.tradekind FROM advancedbehavior AS ab JOIN transactionrecord AS tr ON tr.transreg = ab.translink JOIN trader AS t ON t.tradereg = tr.trdref), counts AS (SELECT tradekind, COUNT(*) AS trade_count FROM matched_trades GROUP BY tradekind) SELECT tradekind AS trader_type, trade_count, 1.0 * trade_count / SUM(trade_count) OVER () AS share_of_total FROM counts;

assumptions.assumption: Each matched trade record counts once, even if it has multiple advanced behaviour records. Traders with a NULL type appear as a NULL group.

alternatives.interpretation: Count advanced behaviour records instead, including multiple analyses of the same trade.
alternatives.sql: WITH counts AS (SELECT t.tradekind, COUNT(*) AS analysis_count FROM advancedbehavior AS ab JOIN transactionrecord AS tr ON tr.transreg = ab.translink JOIN trader AS t ON t.tradereg = tr.trdref GROUP BY t.tradekind) SELECT tradekind AS trader_type, analysis_count, 1.0 * analysis_count / SUM(analysis_count) OVER () AS share_of_total FROM counts;
